args.description: Pixel Heaven native pixel art. Slightly overhead 3/4 RPG view, orthogonal ground (not isometric diamond), upper-left light, crisp 1px clusters, selective dark outlines, warm muted limited palette. Transparent background, no text, no watermark, no scene or ground platform, entire silhouette inside canvas. One leafy oak tree with muted green dense crown, visible warm brown trunk, modest roots, bottom center ground anchor(32,64), 1x1 cell footprint, canopy extends above and sides. No dirt platform.

postProcessing: Uniform integer translation of the complete static object to bottom-centred pivot. No scaling, redraw, per-pixel change or alpha loss.
referenceRightsBasis: Original text description for user project; no third-party image uploaded.
